data.name: Hyatt Regency Mexico City
data.address: Campos Elíseos 204, Polanco, Polanco Chapultepec, Miguel Hidalgo, 11560 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico
data.description:
This sophisticated hotel is a 7-minute walk from Bosque de Chapultepec city park and 2.1 km from the Antara Fashion Hall shopping mall.
The airy rooms feature free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs, plus desks and coffeemakers. Club rooms and suites provide access to a lounge with free breakfast and snacks. Suites add separate sitting areas.
Dining options include a Latin American eatery, a Japanese restaurant and a bakery, plus a Teppanyaki-style grill with a bar and a forest-themed dining room. There's also an indoor pool, a sauna and a fitness center, along with 3 tennis courts, a business center and more than 28,000 sq ft of meeting space.
